messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I found a spike in embed latency tied to the splitter kicking in for large mixed-dim batches. 413s drop but p50 jumps.
Maria: Yep — seen that in the customer telemetry dashboard this morning. Mostly when clients send mixed dims in one payload.
Jamal: Is this the case where we fallback to byte-split because `X-Embed-Dims` is absent? That path does extra memcpy/serial work.
Ciara: Correct. Fastpath = uniform dims -> GPU-friendly. Nonuniform -> splitter does synchronous fanout which inflates latency.
Alex: Repro: client posted ~300 vectors (mix of 512d & 2048d) -> runtime splits into 5 subrequests, each alloc+copy -> +~120ms p50.
Maria: Could we expose a Console cue: "splitter applied" with estimated added latency and cost delta? Would help support and accounts.
Jamal: We need telemetry first: `embed.splitter.count`, `embed.splitter.latency_ms`, label by reason (`dim_mismatch` / `oversize`) + orig_request_id.
Alex: Proposal: implement async fanout path that schedules subrequests without blocking caller thread and attempts to pack into GPU batches.
Ciara: Async fanout sounds good but impacts our latency SLO accounting. Alternative: add `Prefer-Latency: true` client header so SDKs can request smaller, sync-safe batches.
Maria: @Alex can you sketch Console UX for a toggle ("Show splitter details") + a timeline widget for added latency by request sample?
Alex: Will do. Short-term: I'll land telemetry + runbook for support: advise customers to send dims hint header or use SDK batching helpers.
Jamal: Important: billing must account per-original-request not per-subrequest. If we bill each subrequest, customers get double-charged.
Ciara: Agree — propagate `billing.request_id` through splitter and ensure ChargeCalculator dedups by original id.
Alex: I'll open 3 PRs: runtime telemetry, console panel, SDK header helper `embed.batch(..., hint_dims=True)`.
deploy-bot: canary rolled split-async-experiment -> 15% traffic
Alex: :thumbsup: thanks. Also adding a small sample in docs:

```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: X-Embed-Dims: 512,2048
Body: {"input": [<mixed vectors array>], "request_id": "cust-123"}
```

Maria: I'll add a Console dashboard card: "Embed splitter frequency" + "Avg splitter latency (ms)".
Jamal: +1 on telemetry + billing fix. Also add an alert if splitter rate > 1% of embed traffic for a tenant.
Ciara: +1. Let's be careful with rollout flags; start with telemetry-only for a day then enable async fanout.
Alex: Sounds good. I'll post PR links when ready and ping infra for billing audit.
Maria: Thanks all — this should reduce churn on support tickets for "slow embeds".
Jamal: No objections.
Ciara: +1.
